name: Costline
tagline: Every cost of the project on one traceable line: capital, contingency, escalation, operating, lifecycle and end-of-life.
problem: Estimates are rebuilt in spreadsheets at every stage and cannot be traced or tested.
how: Quantities, rates and the cost database
Builds the estimate bottom-up and a should-cost for every package
A traceable estimate and bids tested line by line
features: Capital cost: Direct, indirect and owner’s costs by package, from quantities and unit rates
Contingency and escalation: Contingency from quantified risk; escalation and currency by cost index
Operating and lifecycle cost: Fixed and variable O&M, fuel, major maintenance and replacements
Should-cost: What every package ought to cost, before the market prices it
Bid evaluation: Bids compared line by line against should-cost
Cost database: Rates, quantities and cost per unit of capacity from completed projects
End-of-life cost: Decommissioning cost from the as-built quantities
Import preview: Every change to the estimate diffed and checked before it applies
Package split check: Each package’s share tested against public references
Rate trace: Every rate traced to its quote, quantity and escalation
Market re-pricing: The estimate re-priced as equipment markets move, scenario by scenario
Benchmark position: Cost per kilowatt against comparable plants
